# Prompts

Every instruction Pragma gives a model is written in the code, in English,
and this is where each one is. To read one, open the file.

A call is made in one of five roles, and the role decides which server
answers it: see [Architecture](../explanation/architecture.md#which-server-answers-which-call).

## Sent in the `agent` role

| Prompt | In | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `build_system_prompt` | [`agent/prompts.py`](../../agent/prompts.py) | The agent's system prompt: what it is, how it works in a folder, how it answers. The same for every way of running Pragma. |
| `chat_policy` | [`agent/chat.py`](../../agent/chat.py) | Added in a conversation: how to answer a person across many turns. |
| `project_contract` | [`agent/prompts.py`](../../agent/prompts.py) | Carries the workspace's `PRAGMA.md` into the prompt, with what it overrides. |
| `session_block` | [`agent/prompts.py`](../../agent/prompts.py) | The folder and the date. Last, so that everything before it is the same from one session to the next. |
| `SYSTEM_PROMPT_SUMMARY` | [`core/memory.py`](../../core/memory.py) | Summarises the older steps of a turn that has grown too long. |
| `SYSTEM_PROMPT_COMPACT` | [`core/memory.py`](../../core/memory.py) | Writes the summary a conversation goes on from when it is compacted, by `/compact` or because the window filled up. |

## Sent in the `recall` role

| Prompt | In | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `_CURATOR_SYSTEM` | [`core/curator.py`](../../core/curator.py) | Chooses, before a turn, what the memory holds that is worth showing. |
| `_curator_system` | [`core/curator.py`](../../core/curator.py) | The same instructions, with the paragraph on how much to take rewritten for a project that asked its recall to take more than a few. |
| `_SYSTEM` | [`core/suggest.py`](../../core/suggest.py) | Guesses the line you will type next. Optional. |

## Sent in the `memory` role

| Prompt | In | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `_SYSTEM` | [`core/segmenter.py`](../../core/segmenter.py) | Decides which turns of a conversation are worth keeping. |
| `_EPISODE_SYSTEM` | [`core/tools/episode_consolidate/tool.py`](../../core/tools/episode_consolidate/tool.py) | Writes an episode from what was kept. |
| `_SEMANTIC_SYSTEM` | [`core/tools/episode_consolidate/tool.py`](../../core/tools/episode_consolidate/tool.py) | Draws beliefs from what recurs across episodes. |
| `_EPISODIC_SYSTEM` | [`core/reconsolidate.py`](../../core/reconsolidate.py) | Revises what an earlier episode is taken to mean, when `RECONSOLIDATE_HINDSIGHT` is `false`. |
| `_HINDSIGHT_SYSTEM` | [`core/reconsolidate.py`](../../core/reconsolidate.py) | Writes what a later session shows an earlier episode to have been, beside what it meant at the time. |
| `_SEMANTIC_SYSTEM` | [`core/reconsolidate.py`](../../core/reconsolidate.py) | Rewords a belief that has been contradicted. |
| `_REVIEW_SYSTEM` | [`core/reconsolidate.py`](../../core/reconsolidate.py) | Checks a belief against episodes whose meaning was revised. |

## Sent in the `critic` role

| Prompt | In | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `_SYSTEM` | [`core/critic.py`](../../core/critic.py) | Checks the work of a turn against what was asked. Optional. |

## Sent in the `advisor` role

| Prompt | In | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `_PLAN_SYSTEM` | [`core/advisor.py`](../../core/advisor.py) | Writes the plan of a turn before its first step, `Done when` first, or answers NO PLAN. Optional. |
| `_CONSULT_SYSTEM` | [`core/advisor.py`](../../core/advisor.py) | Tells an agent that has stopped making progress what to do next. Optional. |

The agent's prompt is not one string. It is put together when a conversation
or a run starts: `build_system_prompt`, then what the way of running adds,
then the project's rules, then `session_block`.

The loop also speaks to the model in its own voice while a turn runs — when
the step budget is spent, when a call keeps failing the same way. Those lines
are in [`core/react.py`](../../core/react.py), beside the code that sends
them.
